title: Time Jump — 17:45

fields.narration: It is now 17:45 on Friday, March 13, 2026. The first wave of 14 patients from the multi-vehicle crash with the fuel tanker has arrived. Six are critical. The second wave is en route. The C-212 core has now stabilized and is carrying the clinical networks. The EHR is accessible in read-only mode from select workstations, including BCA-VIEW01 (the Business Continuity Access viewer), but registration, PACS, and secure messaging remain down. Patient tracking is on the paper board in the ED triage area using trauma numbers T-1 through T-14.
worldState: The EHR is now accessible in read-only mode from BCA-VIEW01 and select clinical workstations.
Registration, PACS, and secure messaging remain unavailable.
Patient tracking is active on the paper board using trauma numbers T-1 to T-14.
The second wave of patients from the crash is en route and expected within 15 minutes.
The IT team has confirmed the C-212 core is now carrying the clinical VLANs, but device and PACS VLANs remain unconfigured.
fields.facilitatorNote: This time jump advances the incident to a point where the hospital is beginning to manage the surge under downtime conditions. The IT team has partially restored network access, but critical systems remain offline. The next operational period begins now; players must set objectives and assign roles in the HCC.
fields.scenarioTitle: Core Collapse — Mass Casualty Surge During a Network Outage

instructorNote: This time jump advances the incident to a point where partial EHR access is restored but key systems remain down. The HCC must now set objectives for the next operational period, including patient tracking, surge capacity, and coordination across departments.
